patches_added.name: Don't save search history
patches_added.description: Stops Facebook from adding what you search for to your search history, so there's nothing to clear by hand. Searches already there stay until you delete them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Search.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Save button, the speaker button or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Following feed on Home
patches_modified.description: Makes Home show the newest posts from the friends, groups and Pages you follow instead of Facebook's ranked feed, so you see what they posted rather than what Facebook picks. Home shows, right below it, asks Facebook for one of the Feeds tab's filters (Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages) instead. When that filter has nothing new, Facebook can fill Home with suggested posts and reels, so pair it with Hide "Suggested for you" posts and Hide Reels in the feed. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

Home shows, right below it, narrows Home to one of the Feeds tab's filters (Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages). Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Opening Facebook.

patches_modified.name: Ambient light
patches_modified.description: Fills the black bars around the video with a soft glow of the picture's colours, like Ambient light for YouTube. Configurable in Settings > Video and audio > Ambient light.

patches_modified.name: Danmaku comments
patches_modified.description: Flows regular comments, live chat, and chat replays over videos like NicoNico/bilibili, with native in-app settings, NG words, and no API key.

patches_modified.name: Disable Infinite Upgrade Popup
patches_modified.description: Disables the "Want unlimited access? Get Sankaku Infinite!" upsell popup that periodically appears while browsing the app.

patches_modified.name: Disable OTA bundle updates
patches_modified.description: Always runs the JavaScript bundle shipped in the APK and stops HotUpdater from checking for updates, so over-the-air bundles cannot undo the other patches.

patches_modified.name: Auto claim mission rewards
patches_modified.description: Claims completed My missions rewards and draws their lotteries in the background, without the reward popup or the lottery animation, and shows a short message with the result.

patches_modified.name: SmartNews cleanup
patches_modified.description: Disables SmartNews ad config, native layouts, and reader ad nodes via stable anchors.

patches_modified.name: Auto claim channel points
patches_modified.description: Claim available bonus chests automatically after Twitch's eligibility checks. Coalesces updates and bounds retries for each claim.

patches_modified.name: Block ads
patches_modified.description: Blocks pre-roll, mid-roll and VOD ads, ads stitched into live streams, audio ads, picture-by-picture ads and banner or feed ads, without a third-party server. Can be switched off in the settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat enhancements
patches_modified.description: 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes, local word/user filters, repeat filtering, highlights, timestamps and font size. Configure them from the player menu button.

patches_modified.name: Danmaku chat
patches_modified.description: Flows live chat over the stream like NicoNico/bilibili, with emotes and NG words. Long-press the player menu button to switch it on or off.

patches_modified.name: Fix login
patches_modified.description: Optional workaround for the unsupported app/OS login error after re-signing. Skips Twitch's Play Integrity submission; leave off when login works.

patches_modified.name: Fix notifications
patches_modified.description: Repair push registration after re-signing. Adjusts the certificate header only for HTTPS Firebase Installations requests.

patches_modified.name: Player enhancements
patches_modified.description: Playback speed, seek steps, statistics, sleep timer, VOD chat offset and chapters. Optional public manifest proxy, gestures, layout and Following feed controls in the player menu settings.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps deleted or moderated chat messages readable instead of replacing them with "<message deleted>". The message turns into a tappable spoiler: tap it to reveal the original text. Only text already received by this client can be revealed.

patches_added.name: Block app open reports
patches_added.description: Stops the app from telling BuzzCast every time you open it.

patches_added.name: Disable trackers
patches_added.description: Stops the app from collecting your usage and advertising data.

patches_added.name: Hide rating prompts
patches_added.description: Stops the pop-ups that ask you to rate the app.

patches_added.name: Hide splash promo
patches_added.description: Skips the full-screen promotion shown when the app opens.

patches_added.name: Hide update prompt
patches_added.description: Stops the pop-up that asks you to update the app.

patches_modified.name: Hide home banner
patches_modified.description: Hides the promotional banner in the middle of the home list.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the promotional banner carousel shown in the middle of the home live list.

patches_modified.name: Hide join and follow messages
patches_modified.description: Hides the "joined" and "followed" messages in live chats and the join banner at the top.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the "joined" and "followed the streamer" messages in the live chat and the join banner at the top.

patches_modified.name: Hide live room cards
patches_modified.description: Hides the rotating event and gift cards in the corner of live rooms.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides the rotating event/honor wall/daily recharge cards in the corner of live rooms.

patches_modified.name: Hide live room notice
patches_modified.description: Removes the "healthy live streaming" message shown in every live chat.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the 'healthy live streaming' notice shown in every live chat.

patches_modified.name: Unlock SVIP
patches_modified.description: Unlocks SVIP features and removes ads and purchase pop-ups.
patches_modified.previous_description: Unlocks SVIP features, blocks purchase flow and Unity Ads.

patches_added.name: Delete button in pin menu
patches_added.description: Replaces the WhatsApp button in the menu that opens when you press and hold your saved pin with a trash button that deletes it.

patches_removed.name: Trash bubble on pin long press
patches_removed.description: Replace the WhatsApp bubble in the long-press menu of a saved PIN with atrash can that deletes the PIN.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Forces the premium entitlement in Native Camera. Premium status is stored locally and controls features such as the sub-40-Mbps bitrate cap. Also disables the PairIP license check when the app includes it. Compatible with v1.4, v1.4.1 and v1.4.4.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the Tinder package signature to fix push notifications (Firebase rejects registration when the signature does not match the original).
patches_modified.previous_description: Spoof the Tinder package signature to fix push notifications (Enable to get notifications).

patches_modified.name: Tinder Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads shown between profiles in the swipe deck.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes ads displayed between profiles in the swipe deck.

patches_modified.name: Tinder Remove Upsells
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored chat messages and upsell pop-ups (Likes You, Boost).
patches_modified.previous_description: Remove sponsored messages in the chat and upsell pop-ups (Likes You, Boost).

patches_modified.name: Tinder Unlimited Rewind
patches_modified.description: Makes RewindLastRec.invoke() skip the limit/paywall check and perform the rewind directly.
patches_modified.previous_description: Remove signature verification and enable Rewind locally.

patches_added.name: Dark theme (black background)
patches_added.description: Makes Simosa a dark app: screens, sheets, dialogs and menus use the dark palette (near-black background, light text) instead of the light one, including on Android 12+ where the app would otherwise take a light colour scheme from the wallpaper. The app's own red/orange branding and its white cards are left alone so text on them stays readable.

patches_removed.name: Pure black background
patches_removed.description: Turns Simosa's app background and Material surfaces pure black (#000000) for OLED screens: window, screens, sheets, dialogs and menus go true black and the app keeps its dark theme even when the phone is in light mode. Card and button colours are left as they are so text on them stays readable.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Removes native feed ads (Google GMA), the full-height ad slot, the "Buy with Delivery" promo section (bar, cards and View all), the three item-page banner slots, and the home-screen banner slots from OLX. Pinned to the 18.8.0 build (matches that build's obfuscated feed, item-page and home classes).
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes native feed ads (Google GMA), the full-height ad slot, the "Buy with Delivery" promo section (bar, cards and View all), and the three item-page banner slots from OLX. Pinned to the 18.8.0 build (matches that build's obfuscated feed and item-page classes).

patches_added.name: BYD native battery experiment
patches_added.description: Experimental: sends this BYD's battery and road-load model to Google through Maps' native EV route requests. Starts from the car's own average consumption, learns slowly from BMS energy/distance, and adds in-app vehicle settings. Native hooks inspected on Maps 26.41. Targets BYD DiLink 3; DiLink 5 unverified.

patches_removed.name: Disable Login Requirement
patches_removed.description: Removes login requirement and FTUX paywall screens. Cloud-backed features still require sign-in server-side.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Microsoft OneDS/Aria aggregated-metric and failure-logging dispatch methods, stubs Singular attribution SDK initializers and dispatchers, nullifies ad measurement platform identifiers (AIFA, AppSetId), rewrites default telemetry endpoints inside telemetry packages and custom blocked hosts unscoped to 0.0.0.0, disables cross-sell, Floodgate, HockeyApp and DataTransport components, and strips advertising and preinstall attribution permissions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Neutralizes Microsoft OneDS/Aria lifecycle, aggregated-metric and failure-logging dispatch methods, stubs Singular attribution SDK initializers and dispatchers, nullifies ad measurement platform identifiers (AIFA, AppSetId), rewrites default telemetry endpoints inside telemetry packages and custom blocked hosts unscoped to 0.0.0.0, disables cross-sell, Floodgate, HockeyApp and DataTransport components, and strips advertising and preinstall attribution permissions.

patches_removed.name: Hide Plus preview in chat menus
patches_removed.description: Takes the See preview and Instagram Plus rows out of the menu you get from long pressing a chat in your messages. Your chat options stay. Nothing Plus offers is unlocked. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches_added.name: Glass Press Effect
patches_added.description: Adds vivo-style liquid glass touch feedback: a soft light blooms out from your finger across the keyboard background, and the keys dip slightly and springs back with a small wobble.

patches_modified.name: Theme Follows Dark Mode
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Light & dark pair" menu to the top of Gboard's Themes screen. Choose a theme for light mode and one for dark mode, and the keyboard switches between them when the system dark mode changes.
patches_modified.previous_description: Switches an imported custom theme between its light and dark versions (for example "Frosted Keys Light" and "Frosted Keys Dark") when the system dark mode changes.

patches_modified.name: Adapt to modern displays
patches_modified.description: Adapts the game world to the display: the world height is computed at startup from the screen size, and the scene, pipe and texture geometry follows it, so the game adapts to any screen from 4:3 up through tall phones without bars. On screens shorter than the original 16:9 the background is anchored to the ground, so its skyline and bushes stay sitting on the ground instead of sinking behind it. Also adds display-cutout and immersive window handling and moves the per-frame texture setup to a one-time init call.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adapts the game world to the display: the world height is computed at startup from the screen size (288 units wide, height scaled to the screen, from a minimum of 384), and the scene, pipe and texture geometry follows it, so the game adapts to any screen from 4:3 up through tall phones without bars. On screens shorter than the original 16:9 the background is anchored to the ground, so its skyline and bushes stay sitting on the ground instead of sinking behind it. Also adds display-cutout and immersive window handling (fixes the black bar on tall screens) and moves the per-frame texture setup to a one-time init call (the port's flicker fix).

patches_modified.name: Modernize manifest and resources
patches_modified.description: Makes the game activity the launcher and removes the splash screen and AdMob activity, drops the INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions, raises the SDK levels to the port's min 14 / target 34 (current Android refuses to install the stock target 15), adds an adaptive launcher icon, removes the dead Google sign-in resources, and replaces the sound effects with re-encoded versions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes the game activity the launcher and removes the splash screen and AdMob activity, drops the INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions, raises the SDK levels to the port's min 14 / target 34 (current Android refuses to install the stock target 15), adds an adaptive launcher icon and display-cutout theme settings, removes the dead Google sign-in resources, and replaces the sound effects with the port's re-encoded versions. The app's version is left untouched.
